notes.title: SunnySide Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello SunnySide Fam![/h1]

It has been an amazing week! Huge thank you to everyone who has downloaded, played, streamed, and wishlisted SunnySide over the last 7 days. You are all [b]AMAZING[/b].

Now, let’s clear up a small little thing about the demo: [i]Saving.[/i]

We just want to be clear in letting y’all know that there is nothing wrong with the game’s save system, and it works just fine. We simply removed it because we didn’t think it would be necessary for a demo, the purpose of which is simply for you to try the game and see if you like it. 

[b]Well, y’all told us we were wrong. And we heard you.[/b]

So we’re happy to announce that we’ve made some updates to the Demo, and you can download it now!

[h2]Here’s the change list![/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]SAVING HAS BEEN ENABLED. Simply sleep at your tent to save. [/b]
[*] Fixed the issue with NPCs sometimes not hiding correctly during a cutscene. No more double Gabe.
[*] Fixed the long-running issue of the player not appearing in some cutscene intros.
[*] Skill tree tutorial no longer appears before the player has unlocked the tree.
[*] The battle menu in the inventory now correctly disappears if Sparky's off doing...whatever Sparky does.
[*] Added two new errors that appear when planting crops:
[list]
[*] An error that appears if you try to plant a pack.
[*] An error that appears if the size of the plot is incorrect.
[/list][*] A whole new backup way of watering:
[list]
[*] You can now water crops one by one using any item that is tagged as "can be used as water". This is a cumbersome yet backup way for people to water their crops if they cannot reach a water hose nearby.
[/list][*] Gabe's animals can no longer (hopefully) open the main gates to his ranch area.
[*] The player can no longer pass out while the intro animation to the skill tree is playing.
[*] Time no longer gets stuck on paused when closing the map app (after opened via the hotkey).
[*] Added an accessibility option to disable phone rotation with the cursor.
[*] Added input option to invert camera movement on two axes.
[*] Changed the filling prompt on the gamepad for plots to the right bumper instead of the left.
[*] The Claw Machine and Gacha Machine no longer continue to accept player input even after player not having enough money.
[*] We no longer have two Fridays on the map app side panel.
[*] Reworked how vehicle stations such as bicycle rack work, this means the bicycle now spawns as soon as you build the rack no longer needing to wait a whole day.
[*] Fixed the incorrect blueprint for the Tent build item.
[*] Changed the way our snowman looks for more accuracy.
[*] Can no longer discard tools in the inventory.
[*] Plots of soil should work normally now for planting seeds.
[*] The omikuji tree now works a lot more reliably.
[*] The omikuji tree now supports gamepad.
[*] The omikuji item window no longer stretches the item icon.
[*] The hover menu on inventory items now display the rarity of the item.
[*] Can no longer get hardlocked into the ofuda post purchase window if the player presses Esc instead of continue.
[*] Can no longer click on ofuda boxes without interacting with the ofuda box first.
[*] Can no longer continue to click on the ofuda boxes after buying one.
[*] We now allow the game to accept purchases that would take player's money to exactly 0.
[*] Fixed the incorrect glass material on the bus.
[*] Polished up the animation on the item reveal window and made it faster.
[*] Item reveal window now has the hover menu if it is showing the player an inventory item.
[*] Implemented the "fullness" system onto the omikuji trees.

notes.title: News Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Things have been quiet around here lately - but only because we've been so hard at work behind the scenes. We wanted to update you all to see what we've been getting up to at the studio; what we're working on, whats coming up soon and some exciting plans for the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/d260f1fdd9c54c98e45f9cbc8fc3aee9762f992c.jpg[/img]

[h1] Development Progress [/h1]

[b][u]Farming System[/u][/b]

We've been working hard on programming the farming system to allow players to build/farm/plant a [b]lot[/b] of stuff. Like, [i]a lot.[/i] We truely believe nobody has done it to this scale in a 3D farm-sim before. Obviously there's going to be lots of tweaks and balances, and we need to make sure it works, but we're super excited about this. 

[b][u]Social System[/u][/b]

The social system is at the core of the game and drives your friendships, relationships and quests with all your neighbours and residents. We've made some exciting strides with this system in the past few months - from how you acquire friendship and relationship points, hangouts with your friends and loved ones, as well as how these interactions differ from NPC to NPC, which are now fully designed and being implemented with cutscenes. Check out the last cute 'lil coffee date we went on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/b05b75ab3c7ac87f2b532fcef02024b6ce345a04.gif[/img]

[b][u]Art[/u][/b]

We're currently working on a few things on the art side: winter outfits, in-game portraits, insect and bug drawings to name a few! The character creator metrics have also been tweaked - using a formant axis - giving for greater freedom over how you design your character. 

[b][u]Press Demo[/u][/b]

Our other big development focus has been creating a demo that we can showcase exclusively to press. We want to make this slice of the game the best it can be. We know how good SunnySide is - so we're trying really hard to show press this too! We're hoping to attend events around the globe later on in the year - so getting this press demo right is crucial.

[h1] MVP Test Group [/h1]

A reminder in case you missed it - our publisher Merge Games have opened up their pool of playtesters to [b]everyone![/b] Signing up to the Merge MVP program puts you in a pool of potential testers for their upcoming releases - including SunnySide. While this won't grant you a test spot automatically - it does put you in with a chance of testing the game when we open those doors. So if you wanted to go hands on but missed the alpha backer - make sure and sign up at the link below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/fc8ad886e7f5b9211caf921ad3195ce5beb56b33.png[/img]

Over on our Twitter the SunnySide residents have been pitted against each other - and we're down to the final 3! Gabe, Kat and Sebastian. Make sure to head over to the Twitter today, tomorrow and Thursday to cast your all important final votes and crown a true winner!

We have some exciting news to share about the winner this Friday, so make sure to keep your eyes peeled....

[h1] And that's about it for today...[/h1]

We have so many things coming up that we wish we could show and tell you, but there's not too long to wait now. Below, have some teases at some things to come in the future. notes.title: Final Alpha Update - 0.9.6
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

This update marks the final major update for our alpha access. The focus of this update is a complete overhaul to the cooking system alongside selfie mode, lots of bug fixes and performance improvements!

[h3]New Cooking System[/h3]
We've completely reworked the cooking system! This new system will act as a template for SunnySide's full range of cooking equipment in the final release of the game. The idea is to give you all a robust and fun, yet deep and enagaging cooking system that doesn't overstay its welcome. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/83c813bfaeca16e89d028679e26f85bc33140260.png[/img]

The cutting board's slots have been reduced to 3, and more can be attained via upgrades in the final release of the game. However, since the alpha only has a limited number of recipes, you can still cook all the reicipes on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/13511b5636976ba45507b1f72387c11c00490aa6.png[/img]

We've removed all of non-diegetic UI elements from the cooking system, this means, there is no longer a "Go" or "Cook" button floating on the screen. Instead to start the cooking on the cutting board, simply click on the knife, and to do the same with the grill, simply click on the charcoal (if there is any in the grill). 

The cooking also no longer works off of real-time and instead follows in-game time. This means it is a lot easier to keep track of something that is cooking, since you can just look at the in-game clock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/e35017867e7e1cf4110831e6ce913c6bb045d8fd.png[/img]

We've also fully updated the cookbook app, it is a lot more readable, takes way less space on the screen and provides the same, if not more, of the previous functionality. We're planning to add a auto cook option to the app in the final release of the game so don't fret! The cooking system shall not be combursome!

[h3]Selfies![/h3]
The camera app on your phone has recieved a huge update and can now take selfies! In fact this is now the default mode of the camera when you open the app. You can still switch to the back camera via the right mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/82d5cb820ad4ad8339cbfb13c79e69de43446552.png[/img]

This system will allow you to take selfies with your favourite characters, animals and scenraries and like before, set them as your phone's wallpaper! We encourage you to take as many selfies as you can and share them in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sunnyside]Discord[/url] server! [i]Keep in mind that all of the camera photos are save under: Documents > RainyGames > SunnySide[/i].

[h3]Bug fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Water gauge no longer sticks on screen when the crop is fully watered
[*] Recipes are now discovered correctly
[*] Skill tree no longer stays on screen after interaction is finished
[*] Grass colour during summer is improved
[*] Pressing esc while moving a placed item no longer keep it highlighted
[*] Grill now cooks items such as "Whole fish"
[*] Adjusted the head rotation tolerance on NPCs
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new additions to the game! As always, if you encounter any bugs or issues, please submit them through our bug reporting website, accessible through the pause menu. And for everything else SunnySide, join our Discord sever below:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/sunnyside][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/6d3f34014d4d4877b443c8cfcd88abd71e3f2ef6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: BackerKit Alpha Patch 0.9.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First of all, we’d like to thank you all for playing the game and sharing your feedback and thoughts on the game. The server has been incredibly busy since the launch and while it’s amazing to see all the hype for the game, it’s also a lot of work to make sure all of you can enjoy the game as much as possible!

With that in mind, we put this patch together with performance and major bug fixes in mind, mainly a major overhaul to the Buildmode. This update brings a lot of changes onto the game so starting over is recommended. You might be able to continue your save but it's not officially supported.

[h2]Build System Overhaul[/h2]

During the first week of alpha, we noticed a lot of difficulties with how the build system is structured. While what was in the initial version of the game wasn’t definitive (and still isn’t) we’ve overhauled the whole system to make it much easier for you all to build things around your farm.

This overhaul allows you to deposit items inside blueprints via the drone as well as manually. This means building blueprints that are placed high up or are overlapping with other blueprints is much easier now. You also have an option to automatically fill the blueprint with all the items you currently have when you place the blueprint down.

The newly added “Build Station”, located inside of the shed on the farm, allows you to access the crafting menu as well as the “Build Cache”. Build cache is essentially an endless inventory. Items placed inside the cache can then be pulled automatically into blueprints while placing them down or by depositing them using the drone.

You can toggle “Auto Fill” and “Deposit From Inventory” on the build menu itself. Keep in mind that if “Deposit From Inventory” isn’t checked, the drone will only attempt to pull items from the build cache.

Removing blueprints is now a lot easier as well, just activate deletion mode by clicking on the bulldozer icon. Following this, any blueprint or placed item will outline in red and will be deleted upon clicking. All of the materials that were used during the building of that blueprint will be automatically deposited into the build cache, allowing you to use them immediately to build something else.

Lastly, we realised it’s impossible to tell what a blueprint needs without actually placing it down. To fix this, you can now see the requirements of a blueprint by simply hovering over them in the blueprint list.

[h2]Graphics settings have been updated[/h2]
We’ve adjusted a lot of setting in the engine and made a lot more options available to you guys. This means a lot of our players with lower-end PCs can now access the game. I will say though, while the game is now runnable on lower than minimum requirements, it is not supported officially by us.
If you have problems with trees appearing as blobs, playing around with the settings should render them correctly. If you’re struggling to run the game, the most intensive graphical setting is the shadow quality.

[h2]Minimap new POIs[/h2]
We’ve added Kyle’s fishing shack and the Shinto shrine to the map and minimap so it’s easier to find. 

[h2]Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the sell menu, where spamming the sell button would sell the item multiple times
[*] The phone can no longer be opened while talking to an NPC
[*] The game now saves a lot faster and it is indicated during the loading screen
[*] Map panning speed increased and attached to the zoom level
[*] The map can now be rotated via the right mouse button as well
[*] Can no longer use tools while in air
[*] Buildmode infoboxes now appear correctly
[*] We noticed a lot of players were confused by what build items they had selected using the drone. We’ve added a hover box to the items to give you guys a 3D preview of the building/item as well as the name and description.
[*] Buildmode now places buildings back correctly after the drone is recalled

notes.title: The Backerkit Alpha is Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

Here at RainyGames, we've been super busy creating new content, systems and features to bring a big milestone alongside our Backerkit update. This will be a major update (0.9) for the game and therefore your old saves will not be compatible. [i]~sorry~[/i]

[h2]Backerkit Alpha Patch Notes 0.9[/h2]

[h3]4 New NPCs![/h3]
While SunnySide Alpha's focus is on brigning a sandbox experience to everyone and not spoil the story, we still add as many new characters as we can to the world. This means while there isn't a social system in place, they still play a major role in the gameplay loop and provide you guys with some of the key items in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/db54bd95abb65c64ec54509ef2aef59aee4be8f6.png[/img]

The short and small questline present in the game has not been tweaked and it's still more of a proof of concept than anything.

[b]These new NPCs include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hanako Ishikawa
[*] Hina Nakamura
[*] Kaida Amaya
[*] Kyle Sylvester
[/list]
[h3]6 Animal Variations![/h3]
Each of your favourite farm animamls now have 3 different variations! During the alpha, all of the animals are purchasable through Riverside Ranch albeit at different price points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/da7f14612a673fac44912a3c89c00b43b041525d.png[/img]

Not only do they look different, they each produce a different variation of their products.

[h3]3 New Map Locations![/h3]
Alongside these new NPCs, we've added 3 new major locations on the map for you guys to visit. These locations include:
[list]
[*] Kyle's Mechanic and fishing shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/a73d669f23417cee3fa068f4d5888cb53314537a.png[/img]

A major store location including both the mechanic shop and the bait and tackle shop. For now Kyle's mechanic is not in operation, but you can now purchase anything fishing related from him. Subsequently all the fishing equipment has been removed from Sako's shop.

[*] SunnySide's Promenade

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/2622e3ec7eb7f9500283553d2e79ba1715f03fc4.png[/img]

A lovely promenade, extending quite a bit into the sea. A lovely place to relax at the end of a busy day! 

[*] SunnySide's Shinto Shrine

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/99733a769d5b408510bc52fe72f2e5b6645484d5.png[/img]

One of the major locations of SunnySide, containing both the skill tree and the shop for most of the battle items. While battle isn't availble during the alpha, the skill tree is very much implemented.
[/list]

[i]Speaking of ..[/i]

[h3]New Mechanic: Skill Tree[/h3]
The skill tree has always been a major part of the gameplay loop of SunnySide, and almost all of the systems in the game are designed with that in mind, and we're so happy to finally give you all a taste of how it works and affects gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/984514d1be4eb888adc08fec060a3f5fc689a1d4.png[/img]

Progression in SunnySide is tracked and improved everytime you use a skill. SunnySide keeps track of [b]10 Skill levels[/b] and an overall [b]Character Level[/b]. The more you farm the more XP you gain in the farming category and so on. Every time a skill is leveled up, you gain XP towards your [b]character level[/b] and every time you level up your character you will gain a Skill Point. 

These skill points can then be spent on unlocking new abilities on the skill tree! The skill tree (which is an actual tree) can be accessed in the Shinto shrine of SunnySide: just approach the main building, go up the steps, and you can see or unlock new abilities!

Here at the studio, we think these abilites are a huge improvement to the overall experience of the game, and a fully levelled up player will be able to surf through many of the more time consuming aspects of the game!

[h3]New Mechanic: Cash Registers (Tills) for Shops[/h3]
One of the most annoying problems of shops in the game in the past has been locating the NPC in question to start up their shop dialogue. This is a problem no more! We always planned for this system to work independant of where the NPC is and all that's been in the game so far was more of a quick workaround. However, from this update forward you can now access any shop's purchase or sell window through the cash register at the shop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/4a027bb52abaae7cf7caeac67f4d529504b13c7b.png[/img]

The cash register will have an icon on top of it indicating if it is open or not and it will summon the NPC from anywhere in the map to you as long as the shop is open. You can still access their personal dialogue by speaking directly to the NPCs themselves.

Not only is this a lot more convenient, it also acts as a safe guard for any NPCs planning their escape through the map's floor.

[h3]Complete Inventory Overhaul[/h3]
The inventory of SunnySide has recieved a major overhaul over the past month. Now instead of 32 fixed slots, you have access to 6 different inventories each containing 24 slots. These inventories are categories based on what type of item is allowed inside them, and some items can be placed inside multiple inventories. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/c7be110523c122d61fcb58e0b250fb0dd1d893dc.png[/img]

For instance an apple will go into your [b]Harvest Basket[/b] but you can also place it inside the [b]Bento Box[/b] or the [b]Backpack[/b].

These inventories, per usual, each include a hotbar that can be quickly surfed through outside of the inventory screen. You can switch between different hotbars while running around by using [b]Ctrl + Mouse Wheel[/b].

[h2]Tweaks and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Dialogue
Most of the NPCs now have updated dialogue, so go talk to everyone! Alongside the updated content, the dialogue replies now include a small icon next to the dialogue indicating what that dialogue entails.

[*] Multi-item packs
You can now purchase or recieve items that are in packages and need to be opened before use. You can do this by right clicking on an item inside the inventory.

[*] Physics Improvements
Many items (especially small fruit) tend to penetrate through the map and fall to their demise, the improved physics takes care of this in most cases.

[*] Performance and Frame Rate Improvements
We've hugely improved the performance of the game on both CPU and GPU.

[*] New Settings
Accissibility is always at the top of our list at RainyGames, with that in mind, we've added our very first addition to the long list of accessibility options to come: Colour-blind settings. 
You can toggle between Deuteranopia, Protanopia and Tritanopia options and even adjust the strength.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these new additions to the game! As always, if you encounter any bugs or issues, please submit them through our bug reporting website, accessible through the pause menu. And for everything else SunnySide, join our Discord sever below:

[url=http://discord.gg/sunnyside][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/6d3f34014d4d4877b443c8cfcd88abd71e3f2ef6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Goats and an overhaul to the Shelter mechanic
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone! [/h1]

Hope you all been having a great 2022 so far and enjoying the Kickstarter alpha! This update summarises the work that the team has put together since the Christmas break. We're starting the year with a new category of animals: [b]Goats and Goatlings![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/b1696d78c83ebc5835c0afa568dc064c648142a1.jpg[/img]

You can now purchase these cuties at Riverside Ranch. Just like cows, the goats use the quadruped animal bed and feeders. Unlike cows, however, they produce goat milk which will have extensive use once food crafting is added.

In addition to this, the shelter mechanic and animal AI has seen an upgrade. From now on, you can see a thought bubble above any farm animal's head that tells you if they're hungry, thirsty or ready for milking. Their AI is also improved so that during rain or harsher weather condition, they seek shelter and will not produce anything if they're not sheltered. (or if they can't find shelter, we know they can be a little stupid at times)

Lastly, this update brings many smaller features, bug fixes and improvements. Notably:

[list]
[*] Audio settings are now available via the settings menu
[*] A new random name select option is available when purchasing animals
[*] The new fall prevention system now stops animals and other objects from falling through the map
[*] Bamboo trees collision has improved
[*] Sakura trees colours have been adjusted
[*] The player can no longer get stuck in the cutting board
[*] Snow is no longer collectable
[*] While approaching an animal you can now cancel the task if the character gets stuck
[*] While approaching an animal you can now control the camera
[*] Tab now closes the inventory every time
[*] Various typos and grammar fixes
[/list]


As always, please continue to report bugs and problems via our [url=rainybugs.veratil.dev/][b]Bug Reporting Hub[/b][/url] and for any help or support with the game, make sure to join up our official Discord community:

notes.title: Kickstarter Alpha is Here
notes.content:
That's right, the time has finally arrived! If you've missed the announcements elsewhere, Wednesday, December 22 at 6:00 pm PST, we will be sending out all the Alpha keys for KickStarter Backers!

Honestly, we're so thankful to the entire community who found us in the beginning and has supported us for so long. I know I say it every month, but we really couldn't have done with without you. 

So, to say thank you, we've decided that ALL BACKERS from $20 Early Bird tier and up will be receiving an Alpha Key. Yup. You read that right. All of them. 

We want to make sure this is still fair for all the Backers who backed at the Early Access tiers the first time around, so when the times comes we will be sending you an extra digital key for the full release of SunnySide. This should be sometime around November of 2022, but no promises just yet. 

So Alpha players, here's just a little taste of what you can look forward to on Wednesday. 

We had a stream last week which covered everything included in the Kickstarter update:
[previewyoutube=X6uRq5UfpMc;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll be getting all these updates as well as access to [b]Spring AND Summer[/b] seasons. This means that instead of a 28 day loop of Spring, you'll be getting a 56 day loop of Spring and Summer. 

Additionally, we have a little something special for all the KickStarter Alpha players: 

From December 22 to December 27, the whole team will be going dark and taking a much needed break. To celebrate the seasonal festivities during this time, there will be a temporary graphical overhaul to the SunnySide map that includes snow, decorations, and lots of Holiday vibes. Everything else (crops, seasonal progression, quests, etc) will behave as normal, but with a fun seasonal overlay. Enjoy it while it lasts, because it's going away on Monday the 27th and won't be seen again until the full release of the game. Updates and bug fixes will resume after we return to work on the 27th. 

[h1]RainyBugs[/h1]

Now, the Alpha isn't technically a test (we've got Conlan for QA now) but you're definitely going to run into some bugs. If that happens, we have a handy reporting site that will be sent to you with your Alpha email, so keep an eye out for that!

You can access the bug reporting system [url=https://rainybugs.veratil.dev/]here[/url].

[h1]Publisher Updates[/h1]

Y'all. We finally did it. We officially signed a publisher. All the documents are in order, the money is coming in, and the whole team will be operating full time starting on the first. This is a huge accomplishment for RainyGames, and we are super excited to share all the details with you in the new year, so be on the lookout for more information then. 

[h1]Closing Pre-Orders[/h1]

With a signed publisher comes the closing of pre-orders. We always promised we would give a couple weeks notice before officially closing up the Backerkit, so here it is:
Backerkit Pre-Orders will be ending on January 1, 2022. Please plan accordingly.

[b]All Alpha access will be through Steam on PC, regardless of what platform you've selected for your full copy.[/b]

[h1]More Holiday Fun[/h1]

Our incredible Key Artist (Liz) and Composer (Matt) came together this Holiday season to put something special together for y'all. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=Ee2KedYXMIk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

That's it! Keep an eye on your mailboxes for your Alpha key, and be sure to follow the instructions carefully! 

I know I say this every month, but we could never properly express how much we appreciate each and every person who has and continues to support us. There have been some roller coasters over the last year, and the fact that you all continued to believe in us and trust us really means the world. Hopefully things will level out in 2022 now that we have a publisher backing us, but there are bound to still be issues. Thanks to you all, however, we can go into 2022 with our heads held high and ready for anything, because we know that our fans have our backs! 

So once again, thank you for your continued support!

As for what's ahead of us, once we release the KickStarter Alpha, there will be a couple updates, but mostly we will begin working towards the Backerkit Alpha to be released in February. I'll still continue giving monthly updates next year, but they're going to be a lot smaller moving forward, mostly to allow us more time for game development. If you want to stay up to date, your best bet will be joining our Discord and following us on Twitter, if you haven't already. We're up to about 3,600 people on Discord, and it continues to be the best way to follow RainyGames and SunnySide. We post lots of sneak peeks over there (and special ones for KickStarter backers), stream live development, run  contests, and even ask for suggestions from the community. If you join,   just remember to message me (FemChefSR1) with your KickStarter backer #  (if you backed at one of those tiers) so I can  give you your Backer Tier Role. If you pre-ordered on Backerkit, just send me your proof of purchase via DM, and I'll get you set up with your Backerkit role (new and shiny!).

notes.title: Caves, Smelting and Recycling Update
notes.content:
[b]This will be the final update for the Influencer Alpha. The next update will come with the initiation of the KickStarter Alpha on December 22. [/b]
[i]Influencer Alpha keys will be turned off on January First. [/i]

[h1]Recycle Machine[/h1]
[h3]Everyone has speculated about the recyclable plastic and scrap metal occasionally found while collecting sand at the beach. Well, the answer is finally here: SunnySide loves recycling![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/15bc20713c158f3ae13842e8c1660eb078cde047.jpg[/img]
TechHero is now equipped with a QuickRecyle Point out front, with two active machines ready to turn those useless bits of plastic and metal into much more sought-after resources like plastic pellets and metal nuggets.

Simply walk up to the machine, deposit your recyclable materials and wait for results! If the machine takes longer than a day to process, you can always return the next day to collect your recycled items.

In addition to beaches, from now on you receive recyclable material from consuming any food item with a wrapper or container! Recycling is a big part of SunnySide’s sustainability, so expect to see more recyclable items in the future. We hope you enjoy using this new mechanic as much as we enjoyed making it!

[h1]Kazuki’s Smelting Service[/h1]
[h3]We've expanded Kazuki’s shop to now receive smelting orders! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/37b472f13eb040ad405767e54c6845ca72896e69.jpg[/img]
By clicking on the services button on Old Ishikawa Blacksmith, you can switch to services mode. In this mode, you can customise your order from a list of available items. You will then need to deposit the required materials for that specific smelting order into the box provided and the number of items you receive is determined by how many resources you give Kazuki to work with.

For his services, he will charge you a set fee per item. You can see the cost per item under the Available For Smelt section.

Now that this service is implemented, some of the items have been permanently moved to the smelting menu. These items currently include:
[list]
[*] Iron sheet
[*] Iron rod
[*] Glass
[*] Bolts
[/list]

[i]We’re planning to add a lot more to Kazuki’s smelting services in the future![/i]

[h1]The Caves[/h1]
[h3]Finally, the rumoured caves are here, and they’re spooky![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41423874/aee591cf5c9dcf35ed7c9fa10868a22c8018c7ca.jpg[/img]
The entire team’s been hard at work designing, implementing, and testing the caves over the last weeks. These caves will represent a very significant portion of the game's story in the future, so getting them on the map was a top priority! There is only one level for now, with about 5 more planned. 

The current level of the caves does not, and never will, include monsters, so don't worry about anything coming after you from the darkness. Well, not yet anyway. 

We also want to be very clear that these caves are not intended to look or work like mines. We do have future plans for fast travel, and as a whole the caves of SunnySide are going to be very different from anything you've experienced in other games. We honestly can't wait to share them with you! Happy exploring!

[h2]More changes and quality of life updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The tool wheel can no longer be opened while other menus are open. 
[*] Fixed an issue where holding the tool wheel and opening the inventory would soft lock the game by continuously showing the inventory menu.
[*] Implemented checks for empty items. Items with a solid white thumbnail no longer appear in the game.
[*] Kazuki’s cart menu item counts now line up with each other.
[*] Adjusted in-game weather past day 11.
[*] Tooltip and split stack menu no longer spawn out of the screen bounds.
[*] Item log now counts the number of items received instead of showing an array of similar items.
[*] Adjusted skylight intensity so that shadows and enclosed areas have more accurate lighting.
[*] Adjusted interior lighting of shops and buildings and removed the unnatural sudden change of lighting.
[/list]
